tldr: The Oregon Prosperity Council's June 2026 report on long-term competitiveness comprises an executive summary, five policy chapters addressing economic development, taxes, permitting, site readiness, and talent development, plus six appendices documenting engagement methodology, survey data, listening sessions, and technical research.

bullets.text: Five numbered policy chapters: Economic Development & Structural Reform (ch. 1), Taxes (ch. 2), Permitting & Regulations (ch. 3), Site Readiness & Infrastructure (ch. 4), Talent Development (ch. 5)
Six appendices: Engagement Report, Survey Questions, Survey Data, Listening Session Facilitators' Guide, Submissions & Feedback, Technical Report on Data & Research
